bundles.name: All Included (Classic drinks + Basic Wi-Fi)
bundles.notes: Upcharge vs cruise-only is not published and varies by sailing, so the optimizer skips it until a price is known. Staff gratuities not included (beverage gratuities are). Default US fare type.

lines.name: Celebrity Cruises
lines.notes: Classic drinks ~$90 + 20% service (third-party, Sept 2026); Basic Wi-Fi ~$20/day; specialty dinners $58-67 + 20%. Soft-drink package price not found.

tiers.name: Veranda (incl. Infinite Veranda)
tiers.notes: Edge-class Infinite Verandas: 131-184 sq ft plus 42-45 sq ft enclosed balcony area (TPG figures conflict).

tiers.name: Concierge Class
tiers.notes: Veranda layout + dedicated concierge, welcome lunch, priority dining/excursion support. Priority boarding: sources conflict (left unknown).

tiers.name: AquaClass
tiers.notes: Blu restaurant (AquaClass-exclusive), unlimited thermal suite (SEA Thermal Suite on Edge; Persian Garden on Solstice/Millennium), spa concierge. Size range varies by class.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Sky, Aqua Sky, Celebrity & Signature Suites
tiers.notes: Luminae (suite-only restaurant), Retreat Lounge (Michael's Club on Solstice/Eclipse/Reflection), butler, Premium drinks + Premium Wi-Fi. Laundry and unlimited specialty dining start at Royal Suite. Aqua Sky Suites also get thermal suite access. Retreat Sundeck not on Solstice, Eclipse, Reflection, Constellation, Infinity.

tiers.name: The Retreat: Royal Suite & above (Royal, Penthouse, Edge Villa, Iconic)
tiers.notes: Adds unlimited specialty dining (dinner nightly, lunch on sea days), complimentary laundry + unlimited pressing, unlimited Premium drinks, personalized minibar, thermal suite. Edge Villa and Iconic Suite exist on Edge-class only.
